question: Mulk Raj Anand is the author of _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Untouchable**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Untouchable** is a novel written by Mulk Raj Anand.
 
• The novel was first published in 1935 and is considered one of the pioneering works in Indian English literature.
 
• The story revolves around a day in the life of Bakha, a young Indian "untouchable" or Dalit, and highlights the social injustices faced by the lower castes in India.
 
• Mulk Raj Anand is known for his depiction of the lives of the oppressed and marginalized sections of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** was an Indian writer in English, notable for his depiction of the lives of the poorer castes in traditional Indian society.
 
• He was one of the first India-based writers in English to gain an international readership.
 
• Other notable works by Mulk Raj Anand include **Coolie** and **Two Leaves and a Bud**.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in 1967 for his contribution to literature and education.
